title: VietMed: A Dataset and Benchmark for Automatic Speech Recognition of Vietnamese in the Medical Domain
abstract: arXiv:2404.05659v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Due to privacy restrictions, there's a shortage of publicly available speech recognition datasets in the medical domain. In this work, we present VietMed - a Vietnamese speech recognition dataset in the medical domain comprising 16h of labeled medical speech, 1000h of unlabeled medical speech and 1200h of unlabeled general-domain speech. To our best knowledge, VietMed is by far the world's largest public medical speech recognition dataset in 7 aspects: total duration, number of speakers, diseases, recording conditions, speaker roles, unique medical terms and accents. VietMed is also by far the largest public Vietnamese speech dataset in terms of total duration. Additionally, we are the first to present a medical ASR dataset covering all ICD-10 disease groups and all accents within a country. translated_title: VietMed：面向医疗领域越南语自动语音识别的数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 由于隐私限制，医疗领域公开可用的语音识别数据集十分匮乏。在本工作中，我们提出了 VietMed——一个医疗领域的越南语语音识别数据集，包含16小时带标注的医疗语音、1000小时无标注医疗语音以及1200小时无标注通用领域语音。据我们所知，VietMed 在七个方面是迄今全球最大的公开医疗语音识别数据集：总时长、说话人数量、疾病种类、录音条件、说话人角色、独特医学术语数量和口音种类。VietMed 也是迄今总时长最大的公开越南语语音数据集。此外，我们是首个提出覆盖一个国家内所有 ICD-10 疾病组和所有口音的医疗 ASR 数据集的团队。同时，我们发布了首个面向越南语 ASR 的公开大规模预训练模型 w2v2-Viet 和 XLSR-53-Viet，以及首个……
tldr: VietMed 是迄今全球最大的公开医疗领域越南语语音识别数据集，并首次提供了覆盖所有 ICD-10 疾病组和全国所有口音的医疗 ASR 数据集，以及首个越南语 ASR 公开大规模预训练模型。
en_tdlr: VietMed is the world's largest public medical speech recognition dataset for Vietnamese, and the first medical ASR dataset covering all ICD-10 disease groups and all accents within a country, along with the first public large-scale pre-trained models for Vietnamese ASR.
